newsitem.title: USA: Florida citrus belt mostly dry and cool.
newsitem.headline: Florida citrus belt mostly dry and cool.

text.p: Areas of the Florida citrus belt were mostly dry and cool for the week ended Dec 8, the Florida Agricultural Statistics Service (FASS) said, with harvesting of all fruit very active.
There is very little new growth and most fruit is in good condition and coloring well, Fass said.
According to FASS, caretakers are discing, chopping, and mowing cover crops prior to harvesting and for fire protection.
Additionally, FASS estimated 691,000 boxes of Navel oranges were harvested in the week ended December 8, up from 301,000 boxes in the previous week and 367,000 boxes in the week ended November 24.
An estimated 8,364,000 boxes of early and mid oranges were harvested in the week ended December 8, up from 4,457,000 boxes the prior week and 6,385,000 boxes the week ended November 24, FASS said.
